_comment: Phrases that carry subtext. Each signal: id, pattern (a regex that must work in Python and JavaScript, matched case-insensitively), category (a key in playbook.json), label, implication (what it likely means), feeling (what they're probably feeling), tone (key in tones.json), interest (-3..3), stage (talking, flirting, second_base, dtr, situationship, fading, or null), flag (green, yellow, red or null). Order doesn't matter: the playbook's category order decides which one leads.

signals.pattern: \b(deleted|got rid of|uninstalled|deactivated) (my |the )?(hinge|tinder|bumble|raya|the apps?|dating apps?)\b
signals.label: Deleted the dating apps
signals.implication: A big all-in statement. They're quietly checking whether you'll say 'me too'.

match: wait same, i deleted mine too
sincere: that means a lot. i'm not talking to anyone else either

signals.pattern: \b(busy|hanging) with (other people|someone else|ur other|your other)|\b(ur|your|you'?re|youre) other (guys|girls|people|options|men|women|roster)\b|\b(your|ur) roster\b
signals.label: Checking for competition
signals.implication: A joking way of asking whether they're the only one you're talking to.

sincere: honestly i'm not talking to anyone else. i'm free saturday?

signals.pattern: \b(are|r) (you|u) (seeing|talking to|texting) (anyone|anybody|someone|other)|(seeing|talking to) anyone else\b
signals.label: Asking if you're seeing other people
signals.implication: They want to know where they stand before they invest more.

signals.pattern: \bmy (friends|mom|mum|sister|brother|roommates?|family|bestie|bff|parents) (keep(s)? |always |won'?t stop )?(ask(ing|ed|s)?|talk(ing|s)?) (about|abt) (you|u)\b
signals.label: Their people know about you
signals.implication: You've come up in their life outside the chat. They're testing how you feel about being part of it.

match: omg what do you tell them
sincere: i'd love to meet them honestly

signals.pattern: \b(meet|come out with|hang with) my (friends|people|roommates|family|parents|sister|brother)\b
signals.label: Inviting you into their circle
signals.implication: They're bringing you into their real life, which people only do when it's going somewhere.

signals.pattern: \b(not|n'?t) (really )?(interested in (talking to |seeing |texting )?|talking to |seeing |texting )(anyone|anybody|any1|other)|(only|just) (talking|texting) (to )?(you|u)\b
signals.label: Laying their cards on the table
signals.implication: They've told you they're exclusive. They're waiting to see if you say it back.

signals.pattern: \b(what are we|wat r we|what r we|what is this|where (is|are) (this|we) going)\b(?! (doing|having|eating|getting|watching))
signals.label: 'What are we?'
signals.implication: They want a label or at least clarity. Dodging this is a top reason talking stages die.

signals.pattern: \b(need to|wanna|want to|should|gotta) talk about (us|this|what we are|where this is going)\b
signals.label: Setting up the DTR talk
signals.implication: They want to define the relationship, usually in person. '(in a good way!)' means they're hoping to make it official.

signals.pattern: \b(are we|we) (locked in|official|exclusive|a thing|together)\b|\block(ed)? in (or what|with me)
signals.label: 'Are we locked in?'
signals.implication: A heavy question made light with slang so a 'no' hurts less. They want a yes.

signals.pattern: \b(be my (girlfriend|boyfriend|gf|bf|partner|valentine)|make it official|ask(ing)? (you|u) out (officially|for real))\b
signals.label: Asking to make it official
signals.implication: They're asking you out for real.

signals.pattern: \b(what are we doing (for|tonight|this|later)|we should (go|get|try|do|watch)|our (spot|song|thing|show)|we('re| are) (going|doing|watching))\b
signals.label: Talking in 'we'
signals.implication: They're already picturing you as a unit, a classic sign they're close to making it official.

sincere: i like doing stuff with you, let's do it

signals.pattern: ^(good ?morning|gm|morning|mornin|goodmorning)\b
signals.label: Good-morning text
signals.implication: You're one of the first things on their mind. Daily gm/gn texts are a strong sign it's getting serious.

playful: you're up early, who are you
sincere: good morning, i like waking up to your texts

signals.pattern: ^(good ?night|gn|night|nighty?( night)?|gnight|sweet dreams|sleep well(?!\?)|goodnight)\b
signals.label: Good-night text
signals.implication: They want to end the day with you. Part of the routine-building stage.

playful: night, dream about me or whatever
sincere: goodnight, talking to you was the best part of today

signals.pattern: \b(text|tell|lmk|let me know)( me)? (when|once|if) (you|u|ur|you're) (get |got |are |r )?(home|back|there|safe)|get home safe\b
signals.label: 'Text me when you get home safe'
signals.implication: Protective, relationship-level care.

playful: home safe, you can stop worrying now
sincere: i really like that you check on me

signals.pattern: \b(made me think of (you|u)|thought of (you|u)|reminded me of (you|u|us)|this is (so )?(you|u|us)|so us|literally (you|u|us))\b
signals.label: 'This made me think of you'
signals.implication: You live in their head when you're not talking. A TikTok, meme or song sent this way is a low-pressure way to say 'I like you'.

signals.pattern: (tiktokv?\.com|vm\.tiktok|instagram\.com/(reel|p)/|youtu\.?be|spotify\.com|open\.spotify|x\.com/|twitter\.com/)
signals.label: Shared a link
signals.implication: Sending reels, TikToks or songs is how Gen Z says 'thinking of you' without saying it.

signals.pattern: \b(can i get|what'?s|i need) (your|ur) (opinion|thoughts|advice|take)|which (one|fit|outfit|dress|shirt) (should|do)|(what|wat) do (you|u) think (of|about) (this|my)\b
signals.label: Asking your opinion
signals.implication: They value your input on real-life stuff, a sign you matter beyond flirting.

match: ok send it, i'll be honest
playful: obviously the one i'd steal from you
sincere: love that you asked me. honestly go with the one you feel best in

signals.pattern: \b(miss(ed)? (you|u|ya|talking)|lowkey miss|wish (you|u) were here|can'?t stop thinking about (you|u)|thinking (about|abt|of) (you|u))\b
signals.label: Says they miss you
signals.implication: Direct affection. They're letting you see they're attached.

playful: took you long enough to admit it
good. i was starting to think it was just me
sincere: i miss you too. when can i see you?

signals.pattern: \b(you|u|ur|you'?re)('re|r| are| look| looked| looking)?( so| really| actually| lowkey| hella| rly| sm)* (cute|pretty|hot|fine|gorgeous|beautiful|handsome|adorable|sexy|attractive|stunning|fire|good)\b
signals.label: Compliment on your looks
signals.implication: Clear attraction. Compliments on looks move you from friendly to flirting.

signals.pattern: \b((you|u|ur|you'?re)('re| are|r)? (so |really |actually |lowkey |rly )*(funny|sweet|cool|smart|interesting|easy to talk to|different|the best|a green flag)|i like talking to (you|u)|(you|u) make me (laugh|smile|happy))\b
signals.label: Compliment on who you are
signals.implication: They like you as a person, not just how you look. Good sign for something real.

match: you're easy to talk to too
playful: i know 😌 you're not bad either
sincere: that genuinely means a lot, i feel the same about you

signals.pattern: \b(stop it|stoppp+|omg stop|you'?re making me (blush|smile)|i'?m (blushing|smiling)|smiling at my phone|kicking my feet|giggling)\b
signals.label: Flustered by you
signals.implication: What you said landed. They're enjoying the attention.

signals.pattern: \b(you'?re (trouble|so annoying|a menace|crazy|such a flirt|smooth)|prove it|make me|bet you can'?t|you wish|in your dreams|is that (so|right)|oh really|smooth|nice try|someone'?s confident|we'?ll see about that)\b
signals.label: Teasing / banter
signals.implication: Playful push-pull. Teasing is flirting; they want you to play along.

signals.pattern: \b(who was that|who'?s (that|she|he) (in|on) (your|ur)|saw (you|u) (with|at)|you'?re (probably )?(busy|texting) (with )?(her|him|someone)|must be nice|guess (you'?re|ur|u r|youre|you|u) (busy|popular))\b
signals.label: A little jealous
signals.implication: They noticed someone else around you and it bothered them. Interest, with some insecurity.

signals.pattern: \b(wanna|want to|tryna|down to|u down|you down|are (you|u) free|r u free|when (are|r) (you|u) free|let'?s|we should) (get|grab|go|hang|link|chill|do|see|watch|try|meet|kick it)|(you|u) free (this|tonight|tmrw|tomorrow|on|sat|sun|fri|later)|(lmk|let me know|tell me) when (you'?re|ur|u r|you are|u'?re) free|when (ur|you'?re|u r) free|go out (with me|sometime)|on a date\b|\bkeen (for|to)\b|\b(join|hop in|hop on|get on) (vc|call|the call|ft|facetime|discord)\b|\b(ft|facetime) (later|tonight|me)\b
signals.label: Making a plan
signals.implication: They want to see you in real life, the strongest interest signal in the talking stage.

signals.pattern: \b(wya|where (you|u) at|pull up|slide( thru| through)?|link (up|today|tonight)|come thru|come through)\b
signals.label: Wants to link up now
signals.implication: Spontaneous invite. They want your company, today.

signals.pattern: \b(come over|come to mine|my place|your place|ur place|at mine|movie night at|netflix and chill|stay the night|sleep ?over|spend the night|stay over)\b
signals.label: Inviting you over
signals.implication: They want to be alone with you. Often a step toward getting physical, but 'come over' doesn't mean anything is promised.

signals.pattern: ^(u|you|r u|are you) (up|awake)\??$|\b(u|you) up\?
signals.label: 'U up?'
signals.implication: Late at night this usually means a hookup, not a chat. If it's only ever late-night, they may want something casual.

sincere: i'm up, but i'd rather see you properly. dinner this week?

signals.pattern: \b(wanna|want to|can'?t wait to|wish i could|need to|gonna) (kiss|cuddle|hold|hug|touch|see) (you|u)\b|\b(cuddle|cuddling|kissing|make ?out|making out|in your arms|lay with (you|u)|lie with (you|u))\b
signals.label: Wants physical closeness
signals.implication: They're telling you they're physically attracted and want more contact.

signals.pattern: \b(last night was|had (so much )?fun (last night|tonight|with you)|can'?t stop thinking about (last night|that kiss|earlier)|that kiss|still thinking about)\b
signals.label: Thinking about time together
signals.implication: Good follow-up after seeing each other or getting physical. They want reassurance it meant something to you too.

match: same, last night was so fun
sincere: i had a really good time with you. when can i see you again?

signals.pattern: \b(send (me )?(pics|nudes|something spicy|a pic)|what (are|r) (you|u) wearing|nudes|sexting|horny|dtf|smash)\b
signals.label: Sexual ask
signals.implication: They're pushing toward sexual content. You never owe this, and sharing pictures carries real risks.

playful: you'll have to take me on a date first
sincere: i'm not comfortable sending that, but i'd like to see you in person

signals.pattern: \b(take (it|things) slow|not ready|i'?m not comfortable|not comfortable|not tonight|not yet|too fast|slow down|can we wait|i don'?t (want|wanna) (to )?(rush|do that)|i'?d rather not|not like that|just friends)\b
signals.label: Setting a boundary
signals.implication: A clear limit. How you respond here matters more than almost anything else in the chat.

signals.pattern: \b(don'?t be (boring|a prude|lame|like that|scared)|come on just|if (you|u) (really )?(liked|like|loved|cared about) me (you|u)'?d|prove (you|u) (like|love|trust)|everyone (else )?does it|you owe me|after everything i|why are (you|u) being (so )?(difficult|weird|like this))\b
signals.label: Pressure / guilt
signals.implication: Using guilt or 'don't be boring' to push past a no. That's a red flag, not a flirt.

signals.pattern: \b(who are (you|u) (with|texting)|why (didn'?t|didnt) (you|u) (answer|reply|text back)|send me your location|share (your|ur) location|you can'?t (go|talk to|hang)|delete (him|her|them|that)|i need to know where you are)\b
signals.label: Controlling / monitoring
signals.implication: Demanding to know where you are or who you talk to this early is controlling.

signals.pattern: \b(soulmate|never felt this way|marry (you|u)|my everything|never met anyone like (you|u))\b|\b(you'?re|ur) (literally )?(perfect|the one)\b
signals.label: Very intense, very early
signals.implication: Huge declarations can be sweet, but if this is early and fast it can be love bombing. Watch whether their actions match.

signals.pattern: \b(not like (other|the other) (girls|guys)|different from (other|the other) (girls|guys))\b
signals.label: 'You're not like other girls/guys'
signals.implication: Meant as a compliment, but it's a line, and it puts others down to lift you up.

signals.pattern: \b(been (so |super |really )?busy|i'?m (so |super |really )?busy (rn|lately|this week|these days)|crazy (week|month)|a lot going on|swamped|slammed)\b
signals.label: 'I've been busy'
signals.implication: Could be true. If it comes without a new time or a question back, it's often a soft way of pulling back.

signals.pattern: \b(maybe (another time|next time|some ?time|later)|we'?ll see|i'?ll let (you|u) know|rain ?check|not sure (yet|if i can)|possibly|might be able to|depends)\b
signals.label: Vague maybe
signals.implication: Non-committal. A real yes usually comes with a time; a 'we'll see' without one often means no.

signals.pattern: \b((you'?re|ur) (such )?(a )?(good|great|amazing|the best) (friend|homie|bestie)|like a (brother|sister)|see (you|u) as a friend|just friends|love (you|u) as a friend)\b
signals.label: Friend-zone language
signals.implication: They're framing you as a friend, often on purpose to set expectations.

signals.pattern: \b(not looking for (anything|a relationship)|not (in a place|ready) for (a relationship|anything serious)|focusing on (myself|me|school|work)|don'?t want anything serious|bad timing)\b
signals.label: 'Not looking for anything serious'
signals.implication: Believe them. This is them telling you the ceiling on this.

signals.pattern: \b(sorry (for the |for my )?(late|slow) (reply|response|text)|sorry i (fell asleep|was asleep|was busy|didn'?t see)|just saw this|my phone (died|was dead)|sorry been (mia|awol|off)|sorry i'?m (bad|terrible) at (texting|replying))\b
signals.label: Apologising for replying late
signals.implication: They noticed the gap and care how it looked. A good sign, especially if they keep the chat going.

signals.pattern: \b(hey stranger|long time no (talk|see|text)|been a (minute|while)|it'?s been (a while|forever)|(you|u) still alive|thought (you|u) (forgot|died)|remember me|miss our (talks|chats))\b
signals.label: Coming back after a silence
signals.implication: They're reopening the door. It might be real interest, boredom or 'zombieing'. Their next few texts tell you which.

signals.pattern: \b(random (but|question|thought)|ok but|not to be weird but|this is random|fun fact|update:)\b
signals.label: 'Random but...'
signals.implication: They wanted an excuse to text you.

signals.pattern: \b(what'?s (your|ur) (favorite|fav|fave|love language|biggest|dream|go-?to|type|ideal)|what are (you|u) (looking for|into|like)|tell me (about|something|more)|what made (you|u)|do (you|u) (believe|want|like|prefer))\b
signals.label: Getting-to-know-you question
signals.implication: They're curious about you as a person. Answer properly and ask one back.

playful: that's classified. trade you for yours
sincere: ok i actually want to answer this properly: [your answer]. what about you?

signals.pattern: \b(hbu|wbu|nmu|hyd|and (you|u)|what about (you|u)|how about (you|u)|(you|u)\?|yours\?|how was (your|ur) (day|night|week|weekend|class|shift))
signals.label: Asks about you
signals.implication: Asking back keeps the conversation alive. People who aren't interested stop asking.

signals.pattern: \b(rough day|bad day|stressed|overwhelmed|anxious|so tired of|i can'?t (anymore|do this)|crying|sad (rn|today)|feel like shit|not okay|not ok|mental health|panic attack|lonely|homesick)\b
signals.label: Opening up / venting
signals.implication: They trust you enough to show a hard moment. Support now builds more closeness than any flirt.

signals.pattern: \b(unalive|kill myself|kms|end it all|don'?t want to (be here|live)|want to die|wanna die|self ?harm|hurt myself)\b
signals.label: Possible crisis
signals.implication: This could be a joke, but take it seriously and check in directly.

signals.pattern: ^(hey+|hi+|hii+|hello+|yo+|sup|wsp|wassup|heyy+|hiya|wagwan)[!.]*$
signals.label: Just 'hey'
signals.implication: They want to talk but put the work on you. Stretched letters (heyyy) are warmer than a flat 'hey'.

sincere: hey you! how was your day?

signals.pattern: ^((hey+|hi+|yo+|heyy+|hii+|ok|so)\s*,?\s+)?(wyd|wbu|whatcha doing|what (are|r) (you|u) (doing|up to)|what'?s up|whats good|hyd|wsp)\s*\??$
signals.label: 'wyd'
signals.implication: Low effort, but they thought of you. Late at night it can lean flirty.

signals.pattern: ^(k|ok|okay|kk|cool|nice|true|fr|lol|haha|mhm|mm+|yeah|yea|ya|yep|ye|bet|sure|fine|word|same|real|valid|ight|aight|alr|nm|nun|nothing|nah|idk|lmao)[.!]?$
signals.label: One-word reply
signals.implication: Nothing to work with. Once is normal; a run of these, with no questions back, is how fading starts.

signals.pattern: (!{2,}|\b(omg|yesss+|no way|wait what|i love (that|this|it)|that'?s (so )?(amazing|awesome|cute|sweet|fire)|so excited|can'?t wait)\b)
signals.label: Excited
signals.implication: Real energy. Match it.

signals.pattern: ^(yes+|yess+|ya+|yeah|yea|sure|down|i'?m down|im down|bet|say less|of course|ofc|def|definitely|for sure|fs|absolutely|i'?d love (to|that))\b.*(!|\?|when|where|what time|which)
signals.label: Says yes and moves it forward
signals.implication: Not just a yes: they're asking for the details. They want this to happen.

signals.pattern: \b(wow thanks|cool cool cool|oh great|love that for me|sure jan|ok and\??|and\?|anyways|noted|k then|good for you|thanks for letting me know)\b|/s\b
signals.label: Sarcastic or annoyed
signals.implication: Something bothered them. Ask instead of ignoring it.

signals.pattern: \b(it'?s fine|its fine|i'?m fine|whatever|nvm|never ?mind|forget it|doesn'?t matter|don'?t worry about it)\.?$
signals.label: 'It's fine' (it's not)
signals.implication: Short 'it's fine' or 'nvm' after something unanswered often means they feel let down.

signals.pattern: \b(lowkey|lowk|kinda|sorta|i guess|not gonna lie|ngl|tbh) (like|miss|want|wanna|enjoy|love)\b
signals.label: Playing it cool
signals.implication: Softening words ('lowkey', 'kinda') put in front of a real feeling. The feeling is the point.

signals.pattern: (^|\s)/(j|lh|hj|jk)\b
signals.label: Tone indicator: joking
signals.implication: They tagged it as a joke or lighthearted so it isn't misread.

signals.pattern: (^|\s)/(srs|gen|g|pos)\b
signals.label: Tone indicator: serious/genuine
signals.implication: They tagged this as genuine. Take it at face value.

signals.pattern: \b(streak|keep (the|our) streak|snap me|sc me|add me on snap|my snap is|what'?s (your|ur) snap)\b
signals.label: Snapchat streak / moving to Snap
signals.implication: Moving to Snap or keeping a streak means they want daily, casual contact.

signals.pattern: \b((what'?s|whats|give me|drop) (your|ur) (number|insta|ig|snap|@)|text me instead|add me on|follow me (on|back)|my (number|insta|ig) is)\b
signals.label: Moving off the app
signals.implication: Moving from a dating app or DMs to text or Snap is a step up in interest.

signals.pattern: \b(sorry for (double|triple) texting|i know i just texted|ok one more thing|also\b|oh and|wait (also|one more))
signals.label: Double texting
signals.implication: They aren't playing the waiting game anymore. Comfort and interest.

signals.pattern: \b(remember (when|that)|our (thing|joke|song|spot)|like that time|lol (the|that) (thing|time))\b
signals.label: Inside joke / shared memory
signals.implication: Shared references replace generic slang as people get closer.

match: LMAO i'm never living that down
playful: you're never letting that go are you
sincere: i love that we have stuff like that

signals.pattern: \b(i'?m (so )?(drunk|tipsy|faded|lit)|had (a few|too many) (drinks)?|drunk text)\b
signals.label: Drunk texting
signals.implication: Drunk texts are bolder and more honest, but not a promise. See what they say sober.

signals.pattern: \b(that was (so |really |actually )?(fun|nice|cute|great|amazing)|had (so much |a lot of |such a )?(fun|good time|great time|blast)|(so|really) fun)\b
signals.label: Had a good time
signals.implication: They enjoyed it and want you to know. A good moment to suggest the next plan.

match: same!! we have to do it again
i had so much fun too
sincere: i really had a good time with you. next weekend?

signals.pattern: ^(ok(ay)? )?(see (you|u|ya)( (later|soon|tmrw|tomorrow|then))?|ttyl|ttys|gtg|g2g|talk (to you |to u )?(later|soon|tmrw)|bye+|cya|later(?=[!.]*$)|catch (you|u) later|i'?m heading (out|to bed)|going to (bed|sleep)|gonna (sleep|go))\b
signals.label: Wrapping up the chat
signals.implication: They're ending the conversation for now. Normal, unless every chat ends this fast.
signals.feeling: fine, moving on with their day
